_comment: What the fixture's source would say its addresses are, in the plain format.
Deliberately imperfect in both directions, because a route map is a hint and
the report has to survive it being wrong either way.
Reachable by clicking, and so must stay silent:  / /orders /settings /about
Declared, real, and nothing links to it:         /audit
Declared, and redirects to that same orphan:     /audit-log
Declared and gone (the map is stale):            /legacy-reports
Declared, there, and erroring (the app is bad):  /broken-export
/signup and /feedback are left out on purpose: the walk reaches them, so they
come back as addresses the map failed to declare rather than as findings.
